availability_window_kind.name: availability_window_kind
availability_window_kind.value:
("availability_window"."kind" = 'weekly' and coalesce("availability_window"."weekday", -1) between 0 and 6 and "availability_window"."on_date" is null)
        or ("availability_window"."kind" = 'date' and "availability_window"."on_date" is not null and "availability_window"."weekday" is null)

deal_ask_method.name: deal_ask_method
deal_ask_method.value: ("deal"."payment_asked_at" is null) = ("deal"."payment_ask_method" is null) and ("deal"."payment_ask_method" is null or "deal"."payment_ask_method" in ('online', 'other'))

deal_cash_order.name: deal_cash_order
deal_cash_order.value: "deal"."cash_agreed_at" is null or "deal"."cash_requested_at" is not null

deal_cash_given_order.name: deal_cash_given_order
deal_cash_given_order.value: "deal"."cash_given_at" is null or "deal"."cash_agreed_at" is not null

deal_cash_received_order.name: deal_cash_received_order
deal_cash_received_order.value: "deal"."cash_received_at" is null or "deal"."cash_given_at" is not null

deal_place_length.name: deal_place_length
deal_place_length.value: "deal"."place" is null or char_length(btrim("deal"."place")) between 1 and 200

deal_proposal.name: deal_proposal
deal_proposal.value:
("deal"."proposed_by" is null and "deal"."proposed_method" is null and "deal"."proposed_at" is null and "deal"."proposed_place" is null)
        or ("deal"."proposed_by" is not null and "deal"."proposed_method" in ('meetup', 'delivery') and "deal"."proposed_at" is not null and char_length(btrim("deal"."proposed_place")) between 1 and 200)

deal_scheduled_fields.name: deal_scheduled_fields
deal_scheduled_fields.value: "deal"."status" not in ('scheduled', 'completed') or ("deal"."handover_method" is not null and "deal"."scheduled_at" is not null and "deal"."place" is not null)

deal_completed_confirmed.name: deal_completed_confirmed
deal_completed_confirmed.value: "deal"."status" <> 'completed' or ("deal"."owner_confirmed_at" is not null and "deal"."responder_confirmed_at" is not null)

deal_payment_method.name: deal_payment_method
deal_payment_method.value: ("deal"."paid_at" is null) = ("deal"."payment_method" is null) and ("deal"."payment_method" is null or "deal"."payment_method" in ('cash', 'online', 'other'))

deal_payment_order.name: deal_payment_order
deal_payment_order.value: "deal"."payment_confirmed_at" is null or "deal"."paid_at" is not null

deal_completed_paid.name: deal_completed_paid
deal_completed_paid.value: "deal"."status" <> 'completed' or "deal"."amount" = 0 or "deal"."payment_confirmed_at" is not null or "deal"."cash_received_at" is not null

deal_confirm_after_schedule.name: deal_confirm_after_schedule
deal_confirm_after_schedule.value: ("deal"."owner_confirmed_at" is null and "deal"."responder_confirmed_at" is null) or "deal"."scheduled_at" is not null

message_body_length.name: message_body_length
message_body_length.value: "message"."body" is null or char_length(btrim("message"."body")) between 1 and 2000

notification_fold_idx.name: notification_fold_idx
notification_fold_idx.where: "notification"."read_at" is null and "notification"."fold_key" is not null

offer_amount.name: offer_amount
offer_amount.value: ("offer"."is_reserve" and "offer"."amount" between 0 and 1000000) or (not "offer"."is_reserve" and "offer"."amount" between 1 and 1000000)

perk_limit.name: perk_limit
perk_limit.value: ("perk"."limit_per_student" is null and "perk"."limit_period" is null) or ("perk"."limit_per_student" > 0 and "perk"."limit_period" in ('day', 'week', 'month', 'ever'))

post_price.name: post_price
post_price.value:
("post"."price_kind" = 'amount' and coalesce("post"."price_amount", 0) between 1 and 1000000)
        or ("post"."price_kind" in ('free', 'negotiable') and "post"."price_amount" is null)

post_payment_note.name: post_payment_note
post_payment_note.value: "post"."payment_note" is null or (("post"."payment_online" or "post"."payment_other") and char_length(btrim("post"."payment_note")) between 1 and 100)

post_meetup_location.name: post_meetup_location
post_meetup_location.value:
case when "post"."exchange_meetup"
        then char_length(btrim(coalesce("post"."meetup_location", ''))) between 1 and 120
        else "post"."meetup_location" is null end

report_one_target.name: report_one_target
report_one_target.value: ("report"."post_id" is not null) <> ("report"."student_id" is not null)

report_details_length.name: report_details_length
report_details_length.value: "report"."details" is null or char_length(btrim("report"."details")) between 1 and 500

review_text.name: review_text
review_text.value: "review"."text" is null or char_length(btrim("review"."text")) between 1 and 500

school_name_length.name: school_name_length
school_name_length.value: "school"."name" is null or char_length(btrim("school"."name")) between 1 and 120

student_school_email_shape.name: student_school_email_shape
student_school_email_shape.value: "student"."school_email" is null or ("student"."school_email" = lower("student"."school_email") and "student"."school_email" ~ '^[^@]+@([a-z0-9-]+\.)+edu\.ph$' and split_part("student"."school_email", '@', 2) = "student"."school_domain")

student_handle_format.name: student_handle_format
student_handle_format.value: "student"."handle" is null or (char_length("student"."handle") between 3 and 20 and "student"."handle" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]+(\.[a-z0-9_]+)*$')
